description: Authentication and authorization events from RADIUS/NPS, 802.1X, and Microsoft Entra ID sign-in logs. Source-specific fields (authentication_method, policy_selected, assigned_vlan, radius_result) are kept because they carry authorization context that a generic schema would lose. This schema defines the telemetry source shape only; correlation and detection happen in an external SIEM. Never log shared secrets, passwords, tokens, or private key material.

assigned_vlan.description: Optional. VLAN assigned on success. Omit when authentication failed or no VLAN was assigned.

authentication_method.description: Optional. Method used, for example EAP-TLS, PEAP-MSCHAPv2, or graph-signin-log for converted Entra records.

correlation_id.description: Optional. Opaque identifier for joining related events across sources.

device_identity.description: Optional. Device identity presented during authentication, for example a MAC address or certificate subject.

event_type.description: Required. Fixed value for this event family.

message.description: Required. Human-readable summary. Must not contain secrets, passwords, tokens, or private key material.

network_zone.description: Optional. Zone label used for correlation.

policy_selected.description: Optional. The RADIUS network policy or Conditional Access policy that was evaluated.

radius_result.description: Optional. RADIUS result code. Use not-applicable for non-RADIUS sources such as Entra ID.

severity.description: Required. Severity assigned at the source.

source.description: Required. The authentication service or device that evaluated the request.

device.description: Optional. Device that generated the event, for example nps.example or entra-id.

ip.description: Required. IP address of the authentication service, or the client IP for cloud identity events.

zone.description: Optional. Network zone of the authentication service.

timestamp.description: Required. RFC3339 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred.

user_identity.description: Optional. Human identity that attempted authentication, for example a UPN. Omit for machine-only authentications.

vlan.description: Optional. VLAN context of the request where known.

workload_identity.description: Optional. Non-human workload identity where applicable.
